body:
## Why

CURRENT still pointed to an incomplete historical evidence view and did not distinguish mathematical scope, actual training-domain limits, resource censoring, and repository CI.

## Changes

- Reconnect CURRENT to both frozen P0–P5 evidence snapshots and the experiment protocol.
- Define the HX, regenerative-reference and differentiable-network relationship, repeated-readout behavior, and the limits of applying continuum drift asymptotics to finite QPR.
- Preserve numerical counterexamples, truncated training traces, original42 terminal costs, baseline C1 outcomes, and all six HCSN budget-exhausted outcomes.
- Extend the existing evidence-integrity workflow to the new manifests and linked documents.

This is an evidence entry point and workflow update. It does not grant full training-domain qualification, adequate HCSN training, independent scientific benefit, or overall CI success.

## Validation

- Working-tree integrity: four manifests, five Markdown entry points, 785 manifest-bound files, zero reported errors.
- Independent committed-object verification at local commit 7f0d842eaee4afc01a769a8e37be0bae2d9835bc: 794 distinct regular-file blobs, including the entry points and 187 explicit linked inputs, zero errors; exact source and input bytes unchanged before/after.
- Remote tree 4bb4995c3c1058d268c032a0d15cdfe9297a6ff8 exactly matches the validated local tree.
- Existing formatter entry point passed. Hosted checks for this new head remain separate observations.

Stacked on the terminal/review evidence draft PR #5834. Historical logs, failed attempts and frozen manifests remain unchanged.
